frameBarriers.reason: AEBD90 synchronously waits for visibility before AEC180 advances EFP ticks. The browser yields at the GPU readback barrier; the runtime retains the current frame and schedules the next RAF only after completion. Ordinary frames do not await a readback. A hidden frame renders only while a world entry awaits game-ready, under the same barrier: native keeps updating while inactive (A0F430 OnUpdate; A11650 skips drawing) and finishes loading in CPSMission_OnUpdate (728E10). A visible window that gets no RAF for STARVED_FRAME_MS runs the same delivery-paced maintenance frames. Device disposal cancels pending mapping. Startup also hands the asset owner the device texture features once (port-only texture variants), outside the frame. The frame also derives the own-mover step at its existing call site (the local mover's next frame, or the published own cast displacement adopted as a fixed segment, #1569); the readback ordering above is unchanged by it.
